regions.merged_text: Sarcomic Cancer. Blood Cancer. Hazel Marg. Doreen - Wellwood - 17 - n. Cath. - cancer of the hip ... had pneumonia, was operated on ... then fearful pains in legs ... operated on again and found to be hopelessly cancerous. Enrolled last Thursday (October 18) for one year by discouraged parents when all the doctors agreed there was nothing they could do .... To-night the parents return to say the child was brighter - even sitting up when they went home that night. Now every indication she is improving and will be cured. Nov. 2 - worse - phone call about 9 P.M. 104 2/10 fever - pulse 158 - little hope for over-night. 3rd - rests well after mother phones. Nov. 3rd. a.m. pulse 118 - fever only 102 3/10 Deo Gr. - Nov. 4 9:30 P.M. - Very hopeful Nov. 11 still astonishingly improving. Nov. 18 Mother here to-night. Thank God girl astonishingly better. Dec. 8 Parents here to-night ... Hazel without pain all day. Great hopes now of
